scope: Issue 11 command-result lookup source validation; no runtime certification

runs.environment: Server A disposable Python 3.11 container; synthetic repositories and real temporary SQLite; network disabled; Docker CLI and Git metadata available
Server A disposable Python 3.11 container; network disabled; Git metadata, Docker CLI, GNU coreutils, Python system path and prefetched build wheels available

resolution: The full run passed 703 tests and 75 subtests, skipped six fixture-dependent tests, and failed three source-artifact tests because the test container lacked GNU checksum tools, /usr/bin/python3, and build-dependency downloads. All 11 source-artifact tests then passed with those prerequisites supplied; the test code was unchanged.
limits: Five MariaDB fixture tests and one production-image runtime test require the separate CI fixtures.
Synthetic repository and temporary SQLite validation does not certify deployment, MySQL operational state, or live calls on Server B.
